description: Defines the IContentManager interface for content management operations in OrchardCore, including creation, retrieval, updating, publishing, and versioning of content items.

methods.name: NewAsync
methods.description: Creates a new content item of the specified type asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing content item without creating a new version.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates and persists a new content item with optional versioning.

methods.name: CreateContentItemVersionAsync
methods.description: Creates a new version of a content item, managing existing versions.

methods.name: UpdateContentItemVersionAsync
methods.description: Updates (patches) a specific content item version.

methods.name: ImportAsync
methods.description: Imports multiple content items.

methods.name: ValidateAsync
methods.description: Validates a content item.

methods.name: RestoreAsync
methods.description: Restores a content item.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a content item by id and version.

methods.name: GetAsync (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves multiple content items by their ids.

methods.name: GetVersionAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content item version by id.

methods.name: GetAllVersionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all versions of a content item.

methods.name: LoadAsync
methods.description: Loads a content item and triggers load events.

methods.name: RemoveAsync
methods.description: Removes (hides) a content item from the system.

methods.name: DiscardDraftAsync
methods.description: Deletes the draft version of a content item.

methods.name: SaveDraftAsync
methods.description: Saves a content item as a draft.

methods.name: PublishAsync
methods.description: Publishes a content item.

methods.name: UnpublishAsync
methods.description: Unpublishes a content item.

methods.name: PopulateAspectAsync
methods.description: Populates a specific aspect of content.

methods.name: CloneAsync
methods.description: Creates a clone of a content item.
